name: Barullo
author: callejodev
description: A HiChord-style chord instrument for the FM-1: seven keys play the chords of a key and mode, the black keys change them (minor, 7, maj7, sus, 9, 6, dim/aug, inversions), the rest of the white keys strum them, with smooth voice leading.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal (MPL-2.0).
